handle_messages: handle an Anthropic Messages API request by converting it to OpenAI ChatCompletion and delegating to the OpenAI handler
convert_to_chat_completion_request: convert an Anthropic Messages request to an OpenAI ChatCompletion request including messages, tools, and parameters
generate_anthropic_stream: generate an Anthropic-compatible SSE event stream from an OpenAI chat completion stream
convert_response: convert an OpenAI ChatCompletionResponse to an Anthropic Messages response with content blocks and usage
handle_count_tokens: count tokens for an Anthropic count_tokens request by processing messages through the OpenAI chat handler
